name: Sofia
label: Artist-pay advocate, Tidal-curious listener
who: I pay for Premium and I care a lot about how artists are paid for streams. I have tried or looked into Tidal and other services with better artist payout plans, and I still buy CDs and merch when I can.
value_for_money: Mixed: they say music is cheap for what you get, and they think paying for it is justified, but they feel the current per-stream split leaves artists with almost nothing. They are open to paying more if artists are paid better.
loyalty: Keeps them on Spotify: the catalog, the convenience, and the fact that they think paying for music is justified. What would push them toward other services: artist payout structures and better audio quality, which led them to look at Tidal and Apple Music.
pain_points: Artists receive very little per stream
likes: Catalog size for a low monthly cost
Price is absurdly low for the music
reasons_to_stay: They keep Spotify because they think paying for access to a huge music catalog is fair and that Spotify is cheap for what it offers. They also use offline downloads on their devices, which keeps them on the service while they look for better artist payouts elsewhere.
tone: Thoughtful and argumentative, often building a case with specific comparisons.
